use_hk_cond: use hk.cond to conditionally execute a true or false branch function with Haiku state threading
use_hk_switch: use hk.switch to select and execute one branch from a list based on an index with Haiku state
use_hk_scan: use hk.scan to iterate over a sequence with carry state threaded through each step
use_hk_vmap: use hk.vmap to vectorize a function over an axis while controlling whether RNG keys are split or shared
use_hk_while_loop: use hk.while_loop to loop until a condition is false with Haiku state threaded through the body
